cover.sub: 5 niche ways to become the founder who
cover.title: launches on product hunt and wins the day

inner.title: launch at 12:01
inner.body: the leaderboard resets at 12:01 am pacific, so loops scheduled and emailed its list right then. wait for business hours and rivals get a nine hour head start.
inner.label: 9 hours late

inner.title: build the crowd first
inner.body: loops went in with a 12,000+ newsletter and a waitlist of thousands. if your first ask goes out on launch day, you are already late.
inner.label: 12,000 first

inner.title: votes have weight
inner.body: at hour 20 momen had 400 votes and still sat below a rival with 300. the rival simply had more high weight supporters.
inner.label: 400 lost to 300

inner.title: answer every comment
inner.body: momen's ceo replied to all 100+ comments on launch day. a maker page with no replies looks like nobody is home.
inner.label: 100+ replies

inner.title: ask for support
inner.body: loops asked people for support, not upvotes, and skipped the dm spam. it finished #1 of the day and #1 of the week.
inner.label: #1 of the week

launch day is won
